_comment: How a gate SDK client reads an answer from the control plane's hook gate (POST /api/v1/hook-gate). Run by @intutic/gate's GateClient (packages/gate-js/src/__tests__/client.test.ts) and intutic-clawde's (packages/intutic-clawde/tests/test_gate_client.py); `governanceUnavailable` is the control plane's answer when a check could not run, which its own tests hold it to. A `response` of null is a control plane that cannot be reached. `expect.reasonContains` is matched case-sensitively against the client's reason. GOVERNANCE_UNAVAILABLE is decided as an unreachable control plane is, by the client's failClosed; INVALID_REQUEST is a refusal whatever failClosed says.
